jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Data Center Networks
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to shape the architecture and expansion strategy for our data center metro networks. This highly visible, internal-facing role combines product leadership, technical diligence, and program execution to ensure network investments deliver meaningful business value.

You will own the roadmap for internal network products that enable external services, evaluate whether proposed expansion efforts offer the right technical solution and expected return, and lead cross-functional teams through delivery. Success requires deep metro network expertise, strong financial and analytical judgment, and the ability to turn complex technical decisions into clear, actionable recommendations.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

- Own the product strategy, requirements, and multi-year architectural roadmap for data center metro network solutions and expansion programs.
- Translate topology, diversity, capacity, transport, optical-layer, and point-of-presence decisions into repeatable configurations and reference designs.
- Lead cross-functional expansion programs from evaluation through delivery, coordinating teams, dependencies, milestones, risks, and executive status reporting.
- Evaluate proposed network investments using demand, utilization, capital efficiency, revenue potential, and return-on-investment analysis.
- Establish a consistent framework for prioritizing, approving, deferring, or redesigning metro network upgrades and expansion efforts.
- Build demand models that combine contracted demand, pipeline, market signals, customer architecture plans, and forecast scenarios.
- Assess whether existing internal products and architectural solutions remain the right platforms for future growth, including lower-cost alternatives and associated trade-offs.
- Partner with Product, Network Planning, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Service Delivery, and Sales to drive decisions and execution.

What We Look For in a Candidate

- 8-10+ years of experience in product management, program management, network planning, or network engineering.
- 3+ years of experience supporting metro, data center, optical, packet transport, or related network infrastructure.
- Strong knowledge of metro network architecture, including ring and mesh topologies, route and fiber diversity, point-of-presence and colocation siting, and protection and restoration strategies.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs through planning, decision-making, and delivery.
- Ability to build and defend quantitative demand, investment, and return-on-investment models using incomplete or evolving data.
- Understanding of capital economics, including capital and operating expense trade-offs, payback, internal rate of return, utilization, and unit cost.
- Experience translating complex technical and financial analysis into concise, decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders.
- Ability to influence across Product, Engineering, Planning, Finance, Operations, and Sales in a matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with metro fiber, conduit builds, data center expansion programs, or carrier network infrastructure.
- Familiarity with hyperscaler, neocloud, cloud, or AI infrastructure demand patterns.
- Experience evaluating internal network platforms that support the development and delivery of external services.
- Advanced modeling experience in Excel and experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or another analytical or visualization environment.
- Knowledge of reliability engineering, availability targets, failure-mode analysis, and service-level design requirements.
- Experience developing product roadmaps, reference architectures, lifecycle policies, and investment prioritization frameworks.
- MBA, engineering degree, or an equivalent combination of technical and commercial experience.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Outbound
jobs.description:

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role

As a Principal Product Manager on Lumen’s Outbound Product team, you will lead complex programs that turn product and business priorities into execution and measurable outcomes.

This role is focused on bringing structure and accountability to strategic initiatives that span Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and other teams. You will take broad objectives, define the work required to achieve them, establish ownership and measures of success, and drive execution across the organization.

You will work closely with product and business leaders to identify dependencies, resolve barriers, manage risk, and keep teams aligned around the outcomes we are trying to achieve. This is a senior individual contributor role that requires strong program leadership, business judgment, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence across organizations without direct authority.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

- Lead complex, cross-functional programs tied to key product, customer, and business priorities.

- Turn broad objectives into clear programs with defined outcomes, workstreams, milestones, owners, dependencies, and measures of success.

- Establish the structure, governance, and operating rhythm needed to drive execution across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and partner teams.

- Identify risks, gaps, competing priorities, and decisions early, drive them to resolution, and provide leadership with clear visibility into where support is needed.

- Lead programs supporting product launches, commercialization, customer adoption, migrations, strategic partnerships, and other key product initiatives.

- Partner with Product leaders to connect product and roadmap priorities to the work required across the business, while bringing program, customer, and field insights back into decisions.

- Use customer, product, operational, and financial data to establish baselines, measure progress, identify opportunities, and support decisions.Build repeatable approaches that improve how complex product and commercialization programs are executed across the organization.

What We Look For in a Candidate

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- 10+ years of experience in program management, product management, product operations, technology leadership, or related roles.

- Proven experience leading large, complex programs across multiple teams, workstreams, and organizations.

- Demonstrated ability to take broad or ambiguous business objectives, establish the program structure, ownership, governance, and measures of success, and drive execution.

- Strong analytical and business skills, with experience using data to prioritize work, measure progress, and support decisions.

- Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience managing risks, dependencies, and competing priorities while driving alignment with senior and executive stakeholders.

- Strong understanding of enterprise networking and routing concepts, with the technical fluency to lead programs involving network connectivity and effectively engage Product and Engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Agilist, or equivalent program leadership experience.

- Experience leading programs tied to product commercialization, customer adoption, migrations, transformation, or strategic partnerships.

- Experience with cloud, AI, networking, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, or enterprise technology.

- Experience working with technology partners and analytics platforms such as Databricks, Palantir, or comparable environments.

jobs.description:

The Role

The Product Manager, Marketing Digital Experience – BAU Portfolio owns the operational framework that enables efficient delivery of marketing-driven work across Lumen.com. This role manages the intake, prioritization, governance, and continuous improvement of the Business as Usual (BAU) value stream, ensuring requests are properly scoped, routed, prioritized, and prepared for execution.
Serving as the connective point between business stakeholders and delivery teams, this position helps translate business needs into actionable work while providing transparency into priorities, capacity, timelines, and outcomes. The role partners closely with Campaigns, Creative, Digital Experience (DX), Marketing Operations (MOps), Product Marketing, Analytics, and Technology teams to maintain an efficient and scalable delivery ecosystem.
As a senior individual contributor, this position drives consistency, operational excellence, and continuous improvement through influence, collaboration, and process leadership rather than direct people management.

Work Location

Fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership
Own the operating model for Lumen's Business as Usual (BAU) digital delivery portfolio.
Lead the end-to-end delivery of marketing campaigns, product launches, website enhancements, and operational requests across Lumen.com.
Develop and maintain prioritization frameworks that balance business value, customer impact, delivery timelines, capacity, and risk.
Align BAU work with broader Digital Experience priorities and roadmaps.
Partner with value stream leaders to optimize planning, resource utilization, and delivery effectiveness.
Intake, Prioritization & Delivery Management
Own the end-to-end intake, triage, and prioritization process, ensuring work is aligned to business objectives, delivery capacity, and strategic priorities.
Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve competing priorities, and provide transparency into delivery plans, timelines, and trade-off decisions.
Establish standards, workflows, and governance practices that improve intake quality, delivery readiness, and execution efficiency.
Drive continuous improvement through analysis of intake trends, stakeholder feedback, and operational performance.
Governance & Operational Excellence
Define, implement, and evolve scalable governance, prioritization, and execution frameworks supporting marketing delivery across Lumen.com.
Establish operational metrics, service expectations, and reporting that provide visibility into demand, throughput, portfolio health, and business outcomes.
Identify bottlenecks and lead process improvement, automation, and workflow modernization initiatives that enhance efficiency, predictability, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Promote adoption of governance standards and best practices across partner organizations.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the primary point of coordination among Digital Experience, Campaigns, Creative, Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Analytics, and other stakeholder groups.
Build strong partnerships that enable effective planning, prioritization, execution, and delivery.
Translate business needs into actionable work and facilitate resolution of cross-functional challenges impacting delivery timelines, quality, and business outcomes.
Influence decision-making through data, collaboration, business context, and subject matter expertise while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement
Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that measure portfolio health, delivery performance, stakeholder satisfaction, and business impact.
Partner with Analytics and Digital Experience teams to evaluate performance, identify optimization opportunities, and implement process, workflow, and governance enhancements.
Analyze delivery trends, demand, capacity, and operational metrics to improve efficiency, predictability, and stakeholder experience.

What We Look For in a Candidate

Experience
8+ years of experience in digital experience, product management, marketing operations, campaign management, portfolio management, project management, or a related field.
Experience operating in a complex, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Experience managing intake, prioritization, governance, and delivery across cross-functional teams.
Hands-on experience with marketing work management platforms such as Adobe Workfront.
Experience with web and content management platforms; Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) preferred.
Experience working within Agile and/or SAFe delivery models preferred.
Demonstrated success driving outcomes through influence and cross-functional leadership.
Skills
Strong prioritization, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and delivery plans.
Expertise in process improvement, workflow optimization, and operational excellence.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and evolving business needs.
Continuous improvement mindset focused on scalability, efficiency, and business results.
Excellent collaboration, communication, and relationship-building skills.
Leadership & Influence
Proven ability to lead and influence across cross-functional teams.
Builds alignment among stakeholders with diverse priorities and perspectives.
Brings clarity, structure, and accountability to complex initiatives.
Balances speed, quality, governance, and business outcomes.
Demonstrates ownership and a customer-focused mindset.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role

Lumen is seeking a Senior Lead Technical Program Manager to join the Network Architecture and Engineering organization. In this highly visible role, you will lead complex programs that strengthen network security, modernize infrastructure, manage technology lifecycles, and advance engineering excellence across the enterprise.

You will translate sophisticated technical challenges into executable programs. Success requires broad network fluency, strong technical program leadership, and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous situations.

This is an opportunity to solve consequential technology challenges at scale . You will connect strategy with execution, anticipate who needs to be involved, and organize complex work into coordinated projects that deliver measurable outcomes across Lumen’s network environment.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

- Lead the complex, high-impact network programs from early problem definition and strategy through implementation, stabilization, and operational handoff.
- Create integrated execution frameworks when scope, ownership, solution approach, funding, or sequencing is not yet fully defined.
- Orchestrate multiple programs or workstreams with enterprise dependencies, competing priorities, material risks, and senior leadership visibility.
- Establish governance, decision rights, operating rhythms, success measures, and executive review processes  appropriate to the initiative.
- Drive cross-domain sequencing and readiness across architecture, design, build, lab, test, change, deployment, service readiness, and operations.
- Identify systemic constraints, organizational gaps, and portfolio-level dependencies that may not be visible within individual workstreams.
- Anticipate strategic, technical, operational, financial, vendor, and organizational risks  before they become delivery failures.
- Mentor project and program managers; improve organizational standards for delivery discipline, governance, and executive communication.
- Champion scalable AI-enabled and automated workflows that improve portfolio governance, predictability, engineering productivity, and organizational learning

What We Look For in a Candidate

- Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
- 10+ years of progressively responsible program management experience supporting complex technical, network, engineering, infrastructure, or transformation initiatives.
- Broad understanding of telecommunications networks, including the interaction of network hardware, software, infrastructure, planning, deployment, lifecycle management, and operations.
- Demonstrated experience translating ambiguous technical or strategic  objectives into executable plans, coordinated workstreams, governance models, and measurable outcomes.
- Experience leading multiple interdependent initiatives and resolving cross-functional risks, resource constraints, sequencing challenges, and competing priorities.
- Ability to work credibly across technical and business teams, including Architecture, Engineering, Planning, Operations, Security, IT, Product, Finance, and executive leadership.
- Exceptional communication, facilitation, influence, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and executive decision-support skills.
- Experience using Jira and related portfolio, reporting, documentation, or analytics tools to manage milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and delivery evidence.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading network vulnerability remediation, equipment replacement, software deployment, or technology lifecycle programs.
- Experience working across network domains such as IP, optical, transport, Ethernet, edge, security, cloud connectivity, facilities, service delivery, or operations.
- Experience coordinating planning, testing, change management, deployment readiness, service migration, and operational handoff.
- Familiarity with emerging technology risks, including the potential implications of AI and quantum technologies for network security.
